# pathway enrichment
```{r}

library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
library(pheatmap)
library(ggrepel)
library(readr)
library(tibble)

fp2 <- "WesternRevert_vs_Chow12w.Enrichr_H+C2+C5_table.max5kb.xlsx"

# read both enrichment result sheets
enrich_down <- read_excel(fp2, sheet = "Down", .name_repair = "unique")
enrich_up   <- read_excel(fp2, sheet = "Up", .name_repair = "unique")

# add explicit labels
enrich_down <- mutate(enrich_down, Direction = "Down")
enrich_up   <- mutate(enrich_up, Direction = "Up")

# combine
enrich_all <- bind_rows(enrich_up, enrich_down)

keep_ids <- c(
  "GOBP_POSITIVE_REGULATION_OF_PHOSPHATIDYLINOSITOL_3-KINASE_SIGNALING",
  "GOBP_POSITIVE_REGULATION_OF_LIPID_KINASE_ACTIVITY",
  "GOBP_TISSUE_REMODELING",
  "REACTOME_DISEASES_OF_PROGRAMMED_CELL_DEATH",
  "REACTOME_DNA_METHYLATION",
  "BLANCO_MELO_COVID19_SARS_COV_2_INFECTION_A594_ACE2_EXPRESSING_CELLS_RUXOLITINIB_UP"
)

plot_df <- enrich_all %>%
  filter(ID %in% keep_ids) %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = FoldEnrichment, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    side_fe = if_else(Direction == "Down", -FoldEnrichment, FoldEnrichment),
    ID_label = str_replace_all(ID, "_", " ")
  )

# order pathways by max FoldEnrichment so the strongest is at the top
id_order <- plot_df %>%
  group_by(ID_label) %>%
  summarise(max_fe = max(FoldEnrichment, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(max_fe)) %>%
  pull(ID_label)

plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(ID_label = factor(ID_label, levels = rev(id_order)))

fe_breaks <- pretty(c(-max(plot_df$FoldEnrichment), max(plot_df$FoldEnrichment)), n = 4)
fe_max <- max(abs(plot_df$side_fe), na.rm = TRUE)

p <-
  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = side_fe, y = ID_label, fill = Direction)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.75) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", FoldEnrichment)),
    size = 3,
    vjust = 0.5,
    hjust = if_else(plot_df$Direction == "Down", 1, 0),
    nudge_x = if_else(plot_df$Direction == "Down",-0.03 * fe_max, 0.03 * fe_max)
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0,
             linewidth = 0.6,
             linetype = "22") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = fe_breaks,
    labels = function(x)
      abs(x),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.1))
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(Up = "#588157", Down = "#ae2012"),
    labels = c("", "")
  ) +
  labs(x = "Fold enrichment",
       y = NULL,
       fill = NULL,
       title = "Pathway enrichment") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.line.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top",
    plot.title.position = "plot"
  )

library(svglite)

svglite("PathwayEnrichment_WRvsChow.svg", width = 12, height = 5)
print(p)
dev.off()

```

# motif analysis - load and process
```{r}

file <- "Summary.Contrasts.TF_motif_enrichment.Direction_comp.xlsx"

sheets_use <- c(
  "08w_Western_vs_Chow",
  "WesternRevert_vs_Chow12w",
  "WesternRevert_vs_Western8w"
)

modified <- c(
  "Western vs Chow",
  "Revert vs Chow12w",
  "Revert vs Western"
)

names(sheets_use) <- modified

# read all sheets as text first
df_list <- lapply(names(sheets_use), function(nm) {
  read_excel(file, sheet = sheets_use[[nm]], col_types = "text") %>%
    mutate(Contrast = nm)
})

motifs <- bind_rows(df_list)

# clean and score (log2 enrichment)
motifs <- motifs %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(
        Pval, Qval, Eval,
        target.hits, target.seq.hits, target.seq.count,
        bkg.hits, bkg.seq.hits, bkg.seq.count,
        pct.target.seq.hits, pct.bkg.seq.hits,
        target.enrichment, Enrichment
      ),
      ~ parse_number(.x)
    ),
    TF_name = if_else(is.na(TF_name) | TF_name == "", motif, TF_name),
    Direction = str_trim(Direction),
    score = case_when(
      Direction == "UP_vs_DOWN" ~ log2(Enrichment),
      Direction == "DOWN_vs_UP" ~ -log2(Enrichment),
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(score), !is.na(Qval), !is.na(Enrichment), is.finite(score))

# keep strongest motif per TF per contrast
motifs_best <- motifs %>%
  group_by(Contrast, TF_name) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = abs(score), n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

```

# motif clustering and heatmap
```{r}

heat_tfs <- motifs_best %>%
  filter(Qval < 0.05) %>%
  group_by(TF_name) %>%
  summarise(max_abs = max(abs(score), na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(max_abs)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 30) %>%
  pull(TF_name)

heat_mat <- motifs_best %>%
  filter(TF_name %in% heat_tfs) %>%
  select(TF_name, Contrast, score) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Contrast, values_from = score, values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames("TF_name") %>%
  as.matrix()

contrast_order <- c(
  "Western vs Chow",
  "Revert vs Western",
  "Revert vs Chow12w"
)

heat_mat <- motifs_best %>%
  filter(
    Contrast %in% contrast_order,
    TF_name %in% heat_tfs
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Contrast = factor(Contrast, levels = contrast_order)
  ) %>%
  select(TF_name, Contrast, score) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Contrast,
    values_from = score,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames("TF_name") %>%
  as.matrix()

heat_mat <- heat_mat[, contrast_order]

pdf("20260615_motif_heatmap.pdf", width = 6.5, height = 8)

pheatmap(
  heat_mat,
  scale = "row",
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  fontsize_row = 9,
  color = colorRampPalette(c('#576bc0', '#FFFFFF', '#ca2837'))(50),
  angle_col=90,
  border_color = 'black'
)

dev.off()

```

# scatterplot comparing Revert vs Western
```{r}

scatter_df <- motifs_best %>%
  select(TF_name, Contrast, score) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Contrast, values_from = score, values_fill = 0)

p <- ggplot(
  scatter_df,
  aes(x = `Western vs Chow`, y = `Revert vs Western`)
) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = scatter_df %>%
      filter(abs(`Western vs Chow`) > 0.8 | abs(`Revert vs Western`) > 0.8),
    aes(label = TF_name),
    size = 4
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  labs(
    title = "",
    x = "Western vs Chow (log2 enrichment)",
    y = "Revert vs Western (log2 enrichment)"
  ) + 
  theme(panel.grid=element_blank())

ggsave(
  filename = "20260615_motif_scatterplot_westernvschow_revertvswestern.pdf",
  plot = p,
  width = 11,
  height = 11
)

```
